exportō

exportō, exportāre, exportāvī, exportātum

verb, first conjugation · Conjugation on Wiktionary

carry out; export

In this lexicon

  • export

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Flacc. 67: aurum … ex Ītaliā … Hierosolymam exportārī; Cic. Verr. 2.2.176: magnum numerum frūmentī … Syrācūsīs (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • Cum aurum Jūdaeōrum nōmine quotannīs ex Ītaliā et ex omnibus nostrīs prōvinciīs Hierosolymam exportārī solēret, Flaccus sānxit ēdictō nē ex Asiā exportārī licēret.

    Since gold was regularly exported every year in the name of the Jews from Italy and all our provinces to Jerusalem, Flaccus forbade its export from Asia by edict.Cic. Flacc. 67

    In the entry for export

  • Jam vērō et eārum rērum quibus abundārēmus, exportātiō, et eārum quibus egērēmus invectiō certē nūlla esset, nisi iīs mūneribus hominēs fungerentur.

    Again, there would certainly be no export of the things we have in plenty, and no import of those we lack, if people did not do this work.Cic. Off. 2.13
